messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "gut hormone receptors"
set: ["gut hormone receptors", "activating two gut hormone receptors", "GABA receptors", "adrenergic receptors", "cholinergic receptors", "benzodiazepine receptors", "Thyroid hormone", "GLP-1 hormone", "male hormone", "hormone therapy", "LDL receptors in liver", "binding to mu-opioid receptors", "low adrenal hormone levels", "acts like body's stress hormone", "thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in blood", "drugs that affect thyroid hormone levels"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
